name: Liyfe
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; New Haven, CT, USA; Remote
long_description: Liyfe remote symptom management platform utilizes Artificial Intelligence (AI) to automate oncology nurse triage pathways and high-risk patient detection. It helps you standardize procedures, streamline existing clinical protocols, reduced ER visits and hospitalizations.
one_liner: Digital Nurse to Automate Symptom Assessment and Risk…

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: CEO and co-founder of Liyfe Clinic--the first cancer care telemedicine. 10+ years of clinical experience in Radiation Oncology as a medical physicist. Pioneer on surface imaging on left-sided breast cancer irradiation. 10+ years research  background in machine learning. Trained at Harvard/Mass General Hospital and UC San Diego. Faculty positions at UNC-Chapel Hill, Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, and Yale.
